component.name: Touch Typer
component.summary: Learn and practice touch typing with lessons, stats, and streaks

description.p: Touch Typer is a desktop app for improving your typing speed and accuracy. Work through progressive lessons that build finger placement and muscle memory, then track your performance with detailed per-key statistics, streak tracking, and a heatmap that shows exactly which keys trip you up most.

ul.li: Structured lessons with real-time feedback on speed and accuracy
Code mode — practice typing actual code snippets in multiple languages
Key heatmap — see which keys cause the most errors at a glance
Stats dashboard — per-level speed and accuracy charts over time
Streak tracking — daily activity calendar and milestone badges
Arena — compete against friends or open challenges
